agents.name: Hand off to a care advisor
agents.description: Returns only the public URL where a family requests a free callback from an Elderly Care Match care advisor (typically within 24 hours). Accepts no personal or health data: names, phones, emails, addresses, diagnoses, ADLs, and finances must NOT be sent here, and this agent exposes no endpoint that would accept them. The family completes the form and gives their own consent — a third party cannot consent on their behalf. Text input may be free-form; a JSON data part may be empty. Give the link, then stop.
reasons: The "Hand off to a care advisor" capability can provide a link for families to request a callback from an Elderly Care Match care advisor, which is relevant for senior care needs like meal delivery.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.
